objective: Determine whether v76's heterogeneous fresh-prompt gains arise primarily from correction-magnitude covariate shift or from loss of correction-direction and selected-cell support, without fitting or promoting any new artifact.

frozen_diagnostics.residual: exact BF16 MLP output minus the three-CQ3 baseline MLP output
frozen_diagnostics.correction: frozen v75 hybrid MLP output minus the three-CQ3 baseline MLP output

classification_rule.magnitude_covariate_shift: median prompt directional capacity is at least 0.5 and median deployed fraction of capacity is below 0.8
classification_rule.cell_support_or_direction_shift: median prompt directional capacity is below 0.5

decision.if_magnitude_covariate_shift: derive a prompt-balanced distributionally robust scale estimator at identical cells, codes, bytes, operations, and passes
decision.if_cell_support_or_direction_shift: derive leave-one-prompt-out stable cell support before refitting scales, keeping the same fixed rate
decision.if_mixed_or_well_scaled: jointly regularize selection support and scales under prompt-group risk

claim_boundary: Postmortem geometry diagnosis on the now-open v76 prompts. It may choose the next mathematical estimator family, but cannot fit, validate, promote, or establish quality, throughput, novelty, or a breakthrough.
